command.description: Shell command to execute. Runs via the system shell, with cwd at the sandbox working root.

timeout_ms.description: Foreground execution timeout in milliseconds. Ignored when run_in_background is true. Default 120000 (2 minutes), hard-capped at 600000 (10 minutes).

run_in_background.description: If true, start the command detached and return a job id immediately instead of waiting for it to finish. Retrieve output/status later with the Shell Job Result Tool.
